page_title: NEW 2-2 BOU | Newcastle v Bournemouth 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+10' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90+6' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enes Unal (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch for Ryan Christie.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal! Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 2:2.
90+1' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matt Ritchie (Newcastle Utd) replacing Miguel Almiron.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Joe White (Newcastle Utd) has replaced Lewis Miley.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' Neto displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
83' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
82' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
81' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bournemouth.
79' Here's the change. Antoine Semenyo leaves the pitch and Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) comes on as a substitute.
77' The corner is swung in but Newcastle can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) meets a cross inside the box, but Neto wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
76' Newcastle are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
71' It's time for a substitution. Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) comes on in place of Dan Burn.
71' Here is a change. Justin Kluivert is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
69' 1 - 2 Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) will replace Harvey Barnes.
66' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes a short corner kick.

65' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
64' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:7.
62' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.

61' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Neto gets a hand on the penalty from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
58' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is going to take the penalty!
57' Referee Michael Salisbury awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
55' Referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
55' PENALTY APPEAL by Newcastle, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
53' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
52' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Martin Dubravka and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 0:1.

49' A wild pass somehow finds Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
47' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
45+1' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
41' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth). The linesman signals a throw-in for Bournemouth.

40' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.

38' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
37' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
33' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is behind the touchline and Newcastle will take a throw-in.
28' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Neto is equal to it and makes an easy save.
25' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

22' A rebound on the edge of the box falls to the feet of the unmarked Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd). He doesn't hesitate and shoots towards goal, but unfortunately for him it hits one of his own teammates.
21' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

20' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.

18' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
17' A pass into the box finds Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Martin Dubravka denies him.

16' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
14' Martin Dubravka comes off his line to intercept the corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
13' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Good work from Bournemouth as they win a corner.
11' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
9' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.

5' Kieran Trippier fires a cross into the middle of the box that Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) gets on the end of, but he fails to properly control the header and it spins narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
4' The game is pretty dull as Bournemouth are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
2' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

2' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Michael Salisbury.
